name: Maelstrom's Wrath
label: Quest
description: Maelstrom's Wrath: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Molthor delivers word from King Rastakhan, friend. The royal court is most impressed with your decimation of the Hakkari forces. I am to award you with the final weave in your talisman. Hand it to me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your journey has only just begun, young adventurer. Perhaps one day you will visit the Maelstrom and glance into the heart of the world.
I wish you power and fortitude!
